## Completion and review checkpoint

Use Refs in PR/commit text. Close the issue explicitly only after the protected PR is merged and docs/PROGRESS.json contains acceptance evidence. Automated agent review is not independent human approval. Auth, payment, plugin sandbox, remote-fetch and compute-isolation changes require explicit owner review before merge.
